title: Google ka AI video ab 15 second ka, aur 30% sasta #shorts
description:
AI news: Google ne Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash launch kiya. Ab AI video clip 3 se 15 second tak (pehle 10 second), Google ke mutabik price 30% kam, $0.07 per second 720p video ke liye. Ek clip ko follow-up me edit kar sakte ho (background, light, mausam) bina shuru se banaye. Gemini API, Google AI Studio aur Google Vids me hai; Gemini app me 15-second video Google AI Ultra subscribers ko rollout ho raha hai. Tez sports action aur complex physics par Google ke mutabik kaam jaari hai.

Source (official):
https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/introducing-gemini-omni-1-2-flash/

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Google.

Note: blog crops are our own capture of the official page (key lines highlighted). Photos are free AI-generated illustrations, not real product shots. Synthetic voice.
